definitions.cohort: Traditional excludes boot drops and all scrambles. Includes play action. Proximity counts all defenders; interior push counts initial rush/blitz defenders.
definitions.time: 10 Hz post-integration samples labeled by the engine tick; 0.5 s through outcome inclusive, cap 4.5 s. Shape slices strictly before release/sack/scramble/fumble.
definitions.attached: Any blocker in the declared/observed matchup proxy within 1.5 yd of the rusher. Engaged is separately the engine active block state.
definitions.limitations: NFL PFF blocker labels are unavailable for simulation: proxy unions declared assignments and contacts seen so far. Simulation LOS is its snap line, not a measured football center. Late survivors are a selected subset. Pocket geometry alone is not evidence of causal push.
